senses.gloss: m. (σπαθάριος, v. preced.) carrier of broad sword, one of the imperial body-guard for which tall men would be selected.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:15">Cant. R. to II, 15</cite> <cite ref="A02511"><he>אספסתורין</he></cite> (corr. acc.).—Pl. <cite ref="A01493"><he>אִסְפַּתְרִין</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:15">Ib.</cite> a province (or city) <he>מגדלת א׳ למלך</he> was rearing spatharii for the king. [<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 65">Gen. R. s. 65</cite> <cite ref="P01014"><he>ענקמון</he></cite>.]
